## Core Handyman Services in Edinburgh
1. Flat-Pack Furniture Assembly: Specialists in IKEA PAX wardrobes, beds, desks, bookcases, dining sets, and flat-pack office furniture.
2. TV & Heavy Wall Mounting: Secure mounting of OLED/QLED TVs (up to 85 inches), heavy ornate Victorian mirrors, floating shelves, and radiator covers into historic Edinburgh sandstone tenement walls and stud partitions.
3. Bathroom & Kitchen Silicone Sealing: Removal of mouldy silicone and precision sanitary re-sealing of baths, shower trays, basins, and splashbacks.
4. Interior Painting & Touch-Ups: Clean, sharp room painting, door frames, woodwork, and patch repairs with zero mess.
5. Kitchen Cabinet Vinyl Wrapping: Modern architectural film wrapping for tired kitchen cabinet fronts and worktops.
6. Tenement Odd Jobs & Maintenance: Door lock replacements, curtain pole fittings, blind installations, leaking tap washer fixes, and general household repairs.
